Priya Rao: Auditor asked for RBAC change history + KMS access proof for last quarter. Can we assemble a package?
Leo Chen: Yes. Plan: export CloudTrail + KMS DescribeKey history + GH PR approvals + Splunk decrypt events. Will include PR numbers and screenshots.
Jane Auditor: For ISO/SOC2 we need chain-of-custody: who requested/approved RBAC changes, timestamps, and proof old keys were revoked. Hashes/fingerprints of keys are OK, not raw material.
Sam Nguyen: I can pull PR approval audit (GH enforce required reviews) — PRs: #8423, #8571, #8610. Also have a Splunk query for KMS decrypts: `index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt userIdentity.arn=*` 
Marta Silva: There was a vuln triage in Jan (CVE-2025-1234) that triggered a key-rotation recommendation. Patch applied 2025-01-10, no production incident. I'll include the triage notes and SLA timeline.
Leo Chen: Artifacts I'll include in ZIP: `cloudtrail-q4-export.json`, `kms-rotation-history.csv`, `rbac-snapshot-20250110.json`, `pr-approvals-screenshots.zip`, `splunk-links.txt`, `incident-ref-INC-2025-021.md` and a `control-crosswalk.csv` mapping items to SOC2/ISO controls. Filename: `evidence_package_1768202468.zip`. ETA: EOD today.
Jane Auditor: ETA sounds good. Also request: sample SSO admin approvals for 3 accounts (change approver logs) and proof that the old CMK alias was disabled after rotation.
Priya Rao: Noted. We won't provide key material; we'll provide the KMS metadata + hashed fingerprint and CloudTrail Decrypt/DisableKey events.
Sam Nguyen: Will add DescribeKey history + CloudTrail entries for DisableKey/UpdateKeyDescription. Also include KMS alias history diff. Example Splunk saved search added to package.
Marta Silva: For incident response mapping: I'll attach a one-page mapping that ties each artifact to playbook steps (detection -> triage -> containment -> evidence). Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/incident-evidence-map (internal).
Priya Rao: Tagging @ops-bot to kick off exports so we have consistent timestamps across artifacts.
ops-bot: export job queued. job_id=98765. Targets: s3://redwood-audit/tmp/1768202468/. Expected runtime ~12m. Will post presigned links when done. :white_check_mark:
Leo Chen: Thanks. I'll wait for the job and then assemble zip and upload final package to the auditor bucket with restricted ACL.
Jane Auditor: One more Q: can you include the vuln-triage ticket and evidence that corrective actions were deployed (deploy job ids or release tags)? We need proof of remediation timeframe.
Marta Silva: Will include ticket RFC: TICKET-4821, release tags: `infra@v1.9.3` deployed 2025-01-10. CI job id: 554321.
Priya Rao: Great. Once uploads complete I'll DM the auditor the presigned links and push the crosswalk CSV.
Leo Chen: Uploading package to s3://redwood-auditor-exports/1768202468/evidence_package_1768202468.zip now (restricted read to `auditors@external.redwood`).
ops-bot: export job 98765 completed. artifacts: cloudtrail-q4-export.json (sha256: a3f2...), kms-rotation-history.csv (sha256: b7d9...), rbac-snapshot-20250110.json (sha256: d44e...). Presigned links valid 7 days.
Jane Auditor: Perfect — will review and follow up if anything missing. Thanks all. :+1:
Priya Rao: Thanks team — ping if auditor requests deeper chain-of-custody playback (we can script a signed timeline).
